caliper_mm.basis: derived.thickness; physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 2.0 mm sheet

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: craft EVA ≈ 85 kg/m³ × 2.0 mm [E]

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: compressive initial modulus interpolated at 85 kg/m³ between Chen et al. 2023 (80 kg/m³: 2.77 MPa; 95 kg/m³: 4.27 MPa); used as the bending modulus [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 2.0 mm sheet

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: isotropic foam: same as E_md [E]; physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 2.0 mm sheet

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: closed-cell foams: ν ≈ 1/3 (Gibson & Ashby 1997) [L]

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: compressive initial modulus interpolated at 85 kg/m³ between Chen et al. 2023 (80 kg/m³: 2.77 MPa; 95 kg/m³: 4.27 MPa); used as the bending modulus [E]; physical.nu estimated: closed-cell foams: ν ≈ 1/3 (Gibson & Ashby 1997) [L]; physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 2.0 mm sheet

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: isotropic foam: same as E_md [E]; physical.nu estimated: closed-cell foams: ν ≈ 1/3 (Gibson & Ashby 1997) [L]; physical.caliper_um estimated: nominal 2.0 mm sheet

D66.basis: G12·t³/12 with the estimated G12 above

Ez.basis: isotropic foam: thickness-compression modulus taken as derived.E_md (Pa); physical.E_md_gpa estimated: compressive initial modulus interpolated at 85 kg/m³ between Chen et al. 2023 (80 kg/m³: 2.77 MPa; 95 kg/m³: 4.27 MPa); used as the bending modulus [E]

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t estimated: a scored foam hinge is a half-depth cut; L* ≈ 50 t by analogy with scored board [E]

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: foam is elastic: a cold fold springs back almost fully; a large elastic range stands in for that until heat-forming is modelled [E]

crease_set_rate.basis: physical.crease_set_rate estimated: cold-folded EVA keeps almost no set [E]

score_factor.basis: physical.score_factor estimated: a half-depth score leaves t/2: bending ∝ t³ → (1/2)³ [E]

friction_static.basis: physical.friction estimated: rubbery foam on foam [E]

notes: friction: the card states one foam-on-foam coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented

foam: read from stock.finish (stock-card v1 has no structured foam flag); the sheet is compressible, and not inextensible: its tear_strain 1.3 lets it stretch far beyond paper, so an engine must not assume isometry
